entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
A dream more than 100 years in the making.

An underground railway beneath the heart of Auckland.

The idea was first proposed in the 1920s. It was debated, delayed, rejected and almost abandoned more than once.

Now it’s real.

In Episode 1 of our five-part series on the history of Auckland’s City Rail Link, we look back at the vision that refused to die and the extraordinary engineering challenges that brought it to life — including the remarkable feat of lifting a historic downtown building to make way for New Zealand’s biggest transport infrastructure project.

The journey starts here.
